title: Define a hosted evidence answer
responsibility: Defines the complete accepted structure of hosted evidence, including identity, viewing scope, captures and behavior comparisons.

outputs.name: hostedEvidenceSchema
outputs.description: A strict validation schema covering the read identity, revision scope, after side and nullable before side, scenario coverage and captures, and behavior rows and summary. Uses fixed status choices, 40-character commit hashes, 64-character content hashes, bounded lists and text, and fixed notes/evidence reference names. It rejects undeclared keys. Matching an answer to a particular request requires additional checks outside this schema.
